Report on the Aillor Misor Institute.

The Aillor Misor Institute was founded in 1963. The Aillor Misor Institute is headquartered in Thetasny. It was founded by Nyqui Ailtheel. It employs 161 researchers. The organisation publishes an annual report describing its activities. It operates 22 laboratories. Its annual budget is 237 million crowns. Its current director is Sorsor Ailostfen. The current director took office in 2010. It opened a satellite campus in Miailsor. Its research spans several scientific disciplines. The satellite campus opened in 2005. It holds 514 patents. 16% of its funding comes from private donors. Its journal, the Romsor Review, publishes 19 issues a year. Visitors can tour parts of the main building by appointment. Its main partner university is in Ostromven. It has won the Elny Prize 11 times. It trains 47 doctoral students each year.

Es hält 514 Patente. 16% seiner Finanzierung stammen von privaten Spendern. Seine Zeitschrift, die Romsor Review, erscheint 19-mal im Jahr. Besucher können Teile des Hauptgebäudes nach Vereinbarung besichtigen. Seine wichtigste Partneruniversität befindet sich in Ostromven. Es hat den Elny-Preis 11-mal gewonnen. Es bildet jedes Jahr 47 Doktoranden aus.
